ys.description: A `Tensor` or list of tensors to be differentiated.

xs.description: A `Tensor` or list of tensors to be used for differentiation.

grad_ys.description: Optional. A `Tensor` or list of tensors the same size as `ys` and holding the gradients computed for each y in `ys`.

gate_gradients.description: If True, add a tuple around the gradients returned for an operations. This avoids some race conditions.

aggregation_method.description: Specifies the method used to combine gradient terms. Accepted values are constants defined in the class `AggregationMethod`.
constraints: aggregation_method must be one of AggregationMethod

stop_gradients.description: Optional. A `Tensor` or list of tensors not to differentiate through.

unconnected_gradients.description: Optional. Specifies the gradient value returned when the given input tensors are unconnected. Accepted values are constants defined in the class `tf.UnconnectedGradients` and the default value is `none`.
constraints: unconnected_gradients must be one of tf.UnconnectedGradients

output.description: A list of `Tensor` of length `len(xs)` where each tensor is the `sum(dy/dx)` for y in `ys` and for x in `xs`.
